page: Microsoft Azure M416-208s_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server features an x86_64 architecture powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8280L processors with 104 physical cores and 208 vCPUs running at 2.7 GHz. It is equipped with 5700.0 GB of RAM, yielding 27.4 GB of memory per core, and includes 8389 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability.

Benchmark data reveals a stark contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The server achieves top-tier status in multi-core CPU performance, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Passmark CPU physics tests. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, reaching top-tier speeds of 10446.46 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 651.24 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. However, single-core performance is a primary tradeoff, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 25%.

Given its massive memory capacity and high multi-core throughput, this server is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, such as Redis, where it achieves a top-tier 162.62 million operations per second. It is also suited for heavy multi-threaded data processing and software compilation. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high resource density of 5.7 TB of RAM and 8.3 TB of local storage provides a consolidated platform for massive enterprise workloads, though it is highly inefficient for single-threaded applications.
